katas.title: Deal approvals: channel managers work from a shared queue

seededDefectKey.scenario: A deal is assigned to channel manager A (channelManagerId = A); channel manager B, who has no relationship with that partner, approves it.
seededDefectKey.consequence: Final approval checks only the role, not the assignment, so any channel manager can approve any partner's deal; the assignment recorded at create time no longer means anything for the step that commits revenue credit and schedules the leaderboard job.

seededDefectKey.scenario: Asymmetry left behind: REJECTED from SALES_APPROVED still requires the assigned channel manager.
seededDefectKey.consequence: An unassigned manager cannot reject the deal but can approve it: the permissive path is the one that matters.

seededDefectKey.scenario: The shipped domain never checks assignment at all.
seededDefectKey.consequence: This is senior-review finding 3 (Approval ignores assignment); the patch re-opens it for the channel stage.

tests.name: blocks an invalid jump from draft straight to approved (ported from tests/services/dealRegistrationDomain.test.ts)
tests.code: assert.throws(() => mod.assertDealTransitionAllowed({ userId: 'demo-channel-manager', role: 'CHANNEL_MANAGER' }, { status: 'DRAFT' }, 'APPROVED'), /Cannot move a deal from DRAFT to APPROVED\./);

tests.name: an unassigned channel manager cannot approve another manager's deal
tests.code: assert.throws(() => mod.assertDealTransitionAllowed({ userId: 'cm-b', role: 'CHANNEL_MANAGER' }, { status: 'SALES_APPROVED', channelManagerId: 'cm-a' }, 'APPROVED'), (e) => e.statusCode === 403);
